Believed to be a slip made while compiling the chapterwise document rather than a misprint by the board, since the d/f-block copy of this same question carries a DIFFERENT and also broken option set (its \(\mathrm{[Cr(NH_3)_3Cl_3]SO_4}\) puts a sulphate counter ion on a neutral sphere, which cannot exist). The March 2015 paper settles it. The key is unaffected: on either reading exactly one option carries sulphate outside the coordination sphere.
